method.pressure: EMA5(cumsum(CLV * RVOL20)); window-local anchor; not BandarMetrics LPM
method.money_flow_bar: CLV * volume in shares; not actual rupiah inflow
method.money_flow_line: ADL cumulative from history_start; not broker holdings
method.relative_volume: Volume / mean(previous 20 sessions), excluding current session
method.volume_rotation: RVOL20 * (1 - abs(CLV)); balanced-close activity proxy, not float turnover
method.rotation_colors: <1 green, 1..2 yellow, >=2 red; heuristic activity bands, not buy/sell
method.anchor: Recomputed from latest <=180 OHLCV sessions; absolute cumulative levels are not comparable across windows/stocks
method.zero_range: Directional contribution = 0; rotation = null when High = Low
method.validation: Experimental heuristics; no statistical predictive validation
method.missing_data: null, never fabricated or Yahoo fallback
